systeme.session.aide: Agents can’t act on your behalf: enter your code to be recognized as a person
systeme.journal.vide: Nothing yet. Every command and every rename, by a person or an agent, will show up here.
systeme.historique.vide: No changes recorded in this period. History fills in as readings come in.

systeme.energie.note_circuits: Per-circuit measurement; “Other” = the main meter minus the circuits; costs at each hour’s rate.
systeme.energie.note_historique: History from before Moli comes from Home Assistant’s statistics.
systeme.energie.bandeau.repartition: Today’s breakdown (detailed reading from the main meter)
systeme.infra.sous_titre: The house’s computers, and whether everything’s fine on the tech side.
systeme.infra.alerte.echange: Swap memory full ({pct}%): the machine is running low on memory
systeme.infra.releve_absent: The disk and container report (data/infra.json, written by a script on the host) isn’t there yet.
systeme.infra.releve_ancien: Report from {when}: has the script stopped running?
systeme.hub.retenu: Held ({reason}): enter your code to act here, or approve the request.
systeme.pilotes.z2m.desc: The small wireless sensors and plugs, through Zigbee2MQTT.
systeme.pilotes.hue.desc: Hue bulbs and rooms, through the bridge, live.
systeme.pilotes.tuya.desc: Tuya switches, plugs and shutters, 100% local (no cloud).
systeme.pilotes.reolink.desc: Reolink doorbells and cameras: motion, people, images.
systeme.pilotes.sonos.desc: Sonos speakers: playback, volume, track, and spoken announcements.
systeme.pilotes.helpers.desc: The values the house keeps for itself: house mode, alarm, budget.
systeme.pilotes.philips.desc: Philips TVs (Android TV): power, keys, apps, Ambilight.
systeme.pilotes.frigate.desc: Cameras analyzed by Frigate: people, cars, animals.
systeme.pilotes.igd.desc: The router (UPnP): connection and public address.
systeme.pilotes.presence.desc: Who’s home, based on the phones seen on the Wi-Fi.
systeme.pilotes.telegram.desc: The house’s messages, through the Moli bot, with no relay.
systeme.pilotes.phones.desc: The Moli app: home or away, battery, location, and notifications.
systeme.pilotes.profile.desc: A device described in a few lines (no code), polled regularly.
systeme.pilotes.defaut: A driver: it translates a system of devices into values Moli understands.
systeme.briques.guard.desc: Watches over protected rooms and quiet hours: an agent has to ask, a person approves.
systeme.briques.history.desc: Keeps the history of every value (30 days), for the charts and questions about the past.
systeme.briques.energy.desc: Turns the meters into kWh and euros, hour by hour, from the Linky and the circuits.
systeme.briques.automations.desc: Automations: a graph of “when / if / do”, approved by a person, run by the house.
systeme.briques.assistant.desc: Moli: the conversation that answers, acts (under the guard) and draws the automations.
systeme.briques.cameras.desc: Camera images, never shown to agents for protected rooms.
systeme.page.sous_titre: The house as it runs right now. Everything here updates by itself: a new device or a new module shows up on its own.
systeme.page.mesure: measured on this machine, at the same time
systeme.page.couverture: Moli controls {covered} of the {total} HA devices
systeme.page.sans_piece_aide: Assign them a room in the Workshop: the guard protects bedrooms by their room, so a device with no room slips past it.
systeme.page.bientot_aide: solar production, car… to switch on when you need them
systeme.page.entre_sort: In: what the devices say. Out: their values to the core, and the core’s commands to the devices.
systeme.page.coeur_explique: Everything goes through it: it keeps the state of every value, checks every command (is it valid? is it a protected bedroom? is it during quiet hours?), sends it to the right driver and writes it in the log.
systeme.page.coeur_programme: A single program of {mb} MB, running for {min} min.
systeme.page.surface: {what}. Everything done there goes through the core, and so through the guard and the log.
systeme.infra.pc.act_ouvrir: {name}: open Claude and Codex for the phone
systeme.infra.pc.reveil: {name} is waking up: Claude and Codex will open as soon as the Windows session answers.
systeme.infra.pc.demande: Requested: Claude and Codex are opening (a few seconds).
systeme.infra.pc.reseau: Over the network (Wake-on-LAN): it takes a minute to answer.
systeme.infra.pc.agent_muet: The Moli agent on this PC isn’t answering (it starts with the Windows session).
systeme.infra.pc.sans_agent: To see what it’s doing and start agents from here, you need the Moli agent on this PC.
systeme.infra.pc.capteurs: processor temperature: sensors not installed yet
systeme.infra.pc.session_fermee: The PC answers but the Windows session isn’t open: the agent and the apps only start once you’re signed in. To find it again from here, put it to sleep rather than turning it off.
systeme.infra.pc.allumer_ouvrir: Turn on and open Claude and Codex
systeme.infra.pc.pret: Ready: on your phone, open the Claude app (Code tab) for Claude and the ChatGPT app (Codex) for Codex. You’ll be asked for the house code.
systeme.infra.pc.ensuite: Then, on your phone, open the Claude app (Code tab) for Claude and the ChatGPT app (Codex) for Codex. You’ll be asked for the house code.
systeme.code.pas_de_code: The house has no code yet: setup isn’t finished.
systeme.code.demande_proprietaire: Needed for anything that matters: approving an automation, a protected room… Only you can choose it.
systeme.code.demande_autre: Needed for anything that matters: approving an automation, a protected room… To choose a new one, you need the current code.
systeme.tuya.enregistrees: Tuya keys saved: the battery-powered sensors will show up within a minute.
systeme.tuya.configure: Keys saved (encrypted in Moli): battery-powered sensors and devices behind a gateway go through the cloud.
systeme.tuya.a_configurer: For battery-powered door sensors and devices behind a gateway: paste the Access ID and Access Secret of the Tuya project (Overview tab).
systeme.tuya.code_demande: You’ll be asked for your code. The keys never show up again: to change them, you replace them.
systeme.alexa.connecte: Amazon account connected: {n} speakers and groups driven by Moli.
systeme.alexa.a_connecter: Connect your Amazon account so Moli drives your Echo speakers (music, volume, announcements).
systeme.alexa.erreur: Amazon is not answering right now: Moli tries again by itself.
systeme.alexa.etape1: Open Amazon's sign-in page, on a computer if you can.
systeme.alexa.etape2: Sign in: password, verification code, it all happens at Amazon. It may ask for your credentials twice, or show a captcha.
systeme.alexa.etape3: You land on a "not found" error page: that is expected. Copy its address (it starts with https://www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding) and paste it below within 5 minutes.
systeme.alexa.aide: Moli never sees your password: it shows up as a "Moli" device of your Amazon account, and keeps an encrypted token in its secret store.
systeme.alexa.officieux: Amazon offers no official interface to drive Echo music: Moli uses the Alexa app's, which may change without notice.
